questions.question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The chart represents the demand and production of leather bags by five companies U, V, X, Y, and Z.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/946b38b9dacd52e17ab15b2393e07dbf7973a8af8801e8412ba46c159f42e08f.png] 

The difference between the average demand and average production of the five companies taken together is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total Demand of 5 companies together = (6000 + 1000 + 5000 + 2500 + 6500)

⇒ 21,000

Total Production of 5 companies together = (3000 + 3500 + 2000 + 5500 + 4500)

⇒ 18,500

Required Difference = (21,000 - 18,500)

⇒ 2500

Required average = 2500/5

⇒ 500

**∴ Required average is 500**

questions.question: The perimeter of a rectangle is 86 cm. The numbers representing its area and breadth are in the ratio of 9 ∶ 1, respectively. The breadth of the rectangle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter = 86 cm

Ratio of Area and its breadth = 9 : 1

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 (Length + Breadth)

**Calculation:**

Area ÷ Breadth = 9 : 1

⇒ (L × B) ÷ B = 9 ÷ 1

⇒ L = 9 cm

Now, Perimeter of rectangle = 2 (Length + Breadth)

⇒ 86 = 2(9 + Breadth)

⇒ 9 + Breadth = 43

⇒ Breadth = 34 cm

**∴ Breadth of rectangle is 34 cm**

questions.question: Line AC is a tangent to a circle at point B on it, and PQ is a chord of the circle such that BP = BQ. If ∠ABP = 64°, then find the measure of ∠PBQ.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

BP = BQ

∠ABP = 64°

**Concept used:**

**Tangent chord theorem - **The angle between a chord and a tangent through one of the end points of the chord is equal to the angle in the alternate segment.

Tangents drawn from external point are equal

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a945f5a06ab6ad669e651696e3f08118d2c6143d7cbcdfa93a4686b16855d093.png] 

∠ABP = ∠PQB = 64° [The angle between a chord and a tangent through one of the end points of the chord is equal to the angle in the alternate segment]

Then,

∠PQB = ∠BPQ = 64° [Angle opposite to equal sides]

Now,

In ΔPBQ

⇒ ∠PQB + ∠BPQ + ∠PBQ = 180° [Angle sum property of a triangle]

⇒ 64° + 64° + ∠PBQ = 180° 

⇒ 128° + ∠PBQ = 180° 

⇒ ∠PBQ = 180° – 128° 

⇒ ∠PBQ = 52° 

**∴ The required value of ∠PBQ is 52°**

questions.question: The average age of 35 persons is 40 years. 5 new persons with an average age of 35 years joined them. The average age of all the persons is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average age of 35 persons = 40 years

Average age of 5 new persons = 35 years

**Concept used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of Observations

**Calculation:**

Total age of 35 persons = 35 × 40

⇒ 1400

Total age of 5 new persons = 5 × 35

⇒ 175

Total age of 40 persons = (1400 + 175)

⇒ 1575

Average age of all persons = 1575 ÷ 40

⇒ 315/8 years = 39(3)/(8) years

**∴ Required average is 39(3)/(8) years**

questions.question: In how much time will a sum of Rs.5,000 invested at the rate of 15%, simple interest per annum amount to Rs.6,500?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 5000

Rate of interest = 15%

Amount = Rs. 6500

**Formula used:**

Interest = Amount – Principal

Interest = PRT/100

**Calculation:**

Interest = Rs. (6500 - 5000)

⇒ Rs. 1500

Now, (5000 × 15 × T)/100 = 1500

⇒ 750T = 1500

⇒ T = 2 years

**∴ Required time is 2 years**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods 25% above the cost price. Then, he allows a 40% discount on it. What is the percentage loss?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage change = a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100

Here, markup percentage **a = +25%** and discount percentage **b = −40%**.

Net Profit/Loss % = 25 − 40 + (25 × −40) ÷ 100

Net Profit/Loss % = −15 − 1000 ÷ 100 = −15 − 10 = **−25%**.

The negative sign indicates a **loss**.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Markup % = 25%**, **Discount % = 40%**.
Formulas: MP = CP × (100 + Markup%) ÷ 100 | SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100 | Loss% = (CP − SP) ÷ CP × 100.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b13c6b55202da1232dbc5029b65630f43a189e55f73b15830d408666f8699c86.png] 
⇒ Let **Cost Price (CP)** = 100.
⇒ **Marked Price (MP)** = 100 + 25% of 100 = 125.
⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = 125 − 40% of 125 = 125 − 50 = 75.
⇒ **Loss** = CP − SP = 100 − 75 = 25.
⇒ **Loss %** = (25 ÷ 100) × 100 = 25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

The **Marked Price** is the price listed on the label. **Discount** is always calculated on the **Marked Price**.

Effective Percentage

When a value is increased by x% and then decreased by y%, the net effect is given by **x − y − (xy ÷ 100)**.</p

questions.question: In ΔABC, P and Q are the mid-points of the sides AB and AC, respectively. R is a point on the segment PQ such that PR ∶ RQ = 1 ∶ 3. If PR = 4 cm, then BC is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given PR : RQ = 1 : 3, the total length of PQ is 1 + 3 = 4 parts.

Since PR = 1 part = 4 cm, the total length PQ = 4 × 4 = 16 cm.

By the Mid-Point Theorem, the base BC is twice the segment connecting the mid-points.

BC = 2 × PQ = 2 × 16 = 32 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 32 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ In ΔABC, P and Q are mid-points of sides AB and AC respectively.

⇒ R is a point on PQ such that PR : RQ = 1 : 3.

⇒ PR = 4 cm.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Mid-Point Theorem: The line segment connecting the mid-points of two sides of a triangle is parallel to the third side and is half of its length.

⇒ PQ = BC ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the lengths of PR and RQ be 1x and 3x respectively.

⇒ We are given that PR = 4 cm.

⇒ 1x = 4 cm ⇒ x = 4 cm.

⇒ Length of RQ = 3x = 3 × 4 = 12 cm.

⇒ Total length of PQ = PR + RQ

⇒ PQ = 4 cm + 12 cm = 16 cm.

⇒ According to the mid-point theorem, PQ = BC ÷ 2.

⇒ BC = 2 × PQ

⇒ BC = 2 × 16 = 32 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 32 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mid-Point Theorem

The line segment joining the mid-points of any two sides of a triangle is parallel to the third side and is equal to half of its length.

Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem)

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, the other two sides are divided in the same ratio. (AD / DB = AE / EC).

Centroid of a Triangle

The point where all three medians of a triangle intersect. The centroid divides each median into a 2 : 1 ratio, starting from the vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.

questions.question: The largest six-digit number exactly divisible by 243 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The largest six-digit number exactly divisible by 243

**Formula used:**

Required largest n-digit no. = [(Largest n-digit no.) – (Remainder left when the largest n-digit no. is divided by the provided divisor)].

**Calculation:**

The largest six digit number = 999999

Now,

The largest six digit number divisible by 243 

⇒ (999999/243)

Then, we get remainder = 54

Now,

Required largest n-digit no. = [(Largest n-digit no.) – (Remainder left when the largest n-digit no. is divided by the provided divisor)].

⇒ (999999 – 54)

⇒ 999945

**∴ The largest six-digit number exactly divisible by 243 is 999945**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Calculation:

Factors of 243 = 81 × 3

If any number divided by 9 and 3, that is divisible by 243.

So if we take first option 

Sum of digit of 999945 = 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 4 + 5 = 45

45 is divisible by 9 and 3. So 999945 is divided by 243.

So if we take the second option, 

Sum of digit of 999943 = 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 4 + 3 = 43

43 is not divisible by 9 and 3. So 999943 is not divided by 243.

So if we take the third option 

Sum of digit of 999947 = 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 4 + 7 = 47

47 is divisible by 9 and 3. So 999947 is divided by 243.

So if we take the fourth option, 

Sum of digit of 999949 = 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 4 + 9 = 49

49 is not divisible by 9 and 3. So 999949 is not divided by 243.

**∴ The correct option is 1.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs.9,400 is divided between A, B and C such that the ratio of the shares of A and B is 4 ∶ 3 and the of B and C is 5 ∶ 4. What is the share of C?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Combine the ratios: **A : B = 4 : 3** and **B : C = 5 : 4**.

Balanced ratio **A : B : C** = (4×5) : (3×5) : (3×4) = **20 : 15 : 12**.

Total units = 20 + 15 + 12 = **47 units**.

47 units = **₹9,400** → 1 unit = **₹200**.

Share of C = 12 units = 12 × 200 = **₹2,400**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,400.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total sum = ₹9,400, A : B = 4 : 3, B : C = 5 : 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cddbd55a21a290d50c906284f9b492c63269a80f644138c3e18b2637f4daf691.png] 

**Formula Used:** Ratio equalization and division of sum.

⇒ A : B = 4 : 3 (multiply by 5) = 20 : 15

⇒ B : C = 5 : 4 (multiply by 3) = 15 : 12

⇒ Combined Ratio A : B : C = 20 : 15 : 12

⇒ Sum of parts = 20 + 15 + 12 = 47

⇒ Share of C = (12 ÷ 47) × 9400

⇒ Share of C = 12 × 200 = 2400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,400.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios like a:b and c:d are given, the compound ratio is calculated as (a×c) : (b×d).

Ratio Equalization

To combine A:B and B:C, make the common term (B) equal by multiplying the ratios with suitable constants.

Proportional Division

Share of a component = (Specific Ratio Part ÷ Total Ratio Parts) × Total Value.

questions.question: Ram sold a plot for Rs.6,55,000 at 20% loss. For what price should be sell the plot to gain 15% profit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP = Rs. 6,55,000

Loss% = 20%

New Profit = 15%

**Calculation:**

Let CP be 100x

Now, SP after 20% loss = Rs. 100x × (100 – 20)%

⇒ Rs. 80x

And, SP after 15% profit = Rs. 100x × (100 + 15)%

⇒ Rs. 115x

According to the question,

⇒ 80x = Rs. 6,55,000

⇒ 115x = Rs. (6,55,000/80) × 115

⇒ Rs. 941,562.50

**∴ Required SP is Rs. 941,562.50**

questions.question: Two parallel chords are drawn in a circle of diameter 50 cm on the opposite sides of its centre. The length of one chord is 40 cm and the distance between the two chords is 22 cm. The length of the other chord is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diameter of the circle = 50 cm

The length of one chord = 40 cm

The distance between the two chords = 22 cm

**Formula used:**

H² = B² + P²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1767f909c17965a76a9170c5def41389f5e2f72e91c6ef7680c0010ad02c315c.png] 

AB and PQ are two chords, and O is the centre of the circle.

M is the midpoint of AB and N is the midpoint of PQ

OB = OQ = 25 cm [radius of the circle]

AB = 40 cm and MN = 22 cm

Let OM = x

Then,

ON = (22 – x) cm

MB = 40/2 = 20 cm

In ΔMOB

(OB)² = (OM)² + (MB)²

⇒ (25)² = (OM)² + (20)²

⇒ 625 = (OM)² + 400

⇒ (OM)² = (625 – 400)

⇒ (OM)² = 225

⇒ OM = 15 cm

Now,

ON = (22 – x) = (22 – 15) 

⇒ ON = 7 cm

In ΔONQ

(OQ)² = (ON)² + (NQ)²

⇒ (25)² = (7)² + (NQ)²

⇒ 625 = 49 + (NQ)²

⇒ (NQ)² = (625 – 49)

⇒ (NQ)² = 576

⇒ NQ = 24 cm

PQ = 2NQ

⇒ PQ = 2 × 24 cm

⇒ PQ = 48 cm

**∴ The length of the other chord is 48 cm**

questions.question: Varun and Gaurav can dig a pond in 10 days and 18 days, respectively. After finishing that work together, they receive an amount of Rs.7,280. What is the share of Gaurav in that amount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Varun to dig a pond = 10 days

Time taken by Gaurav to dig a pond = 18 days

Total amount received = Rs. 7280

**Concept used:**

Amount shared will be as per the efficiency of Varun and Gaurav

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10 and 18 = 90 = Total work

Efficiency of Varun = 90/10 = 9 units/day

Efficiency of Gaurav = 90/18 = 5 units/day

Share of Gaurav = Rs. 7280 × (5/14)

⇒ Rs. 2600

**∴ Share of Gaurav is Rs. 2600**

questions.question: If 3a - b = 1 and ab = 4, then the value of (9a² - b²) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

3a – b = 1 and ab = 4

**Formula used:**

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab 

**Calculation:**

3a – b = 1

squaring both sides

(3a)² + (b)² – 2 × 3a × b = (1)²

⇒ 9a² + b² – 6ab = 1

Adding 12ab both sides, we get

⇒ 9a2 + b2 – 6ab + 12ab = 1 + 12ab

⇒ 9a² + b² + 6ab = 1 + 12ab

⇒ (3a + b)² = 1 + 12ab

⇒ (3a + b)² = 1 + 12 × 4

⇒ (3a + b)² = 1 + 48

⇒ (3a + b)² = 49

⇒ (3a + b)² = 7²

⇒ (3a + b) = 7

Now,

(9a2 - b2) = (3a - b)(3a + b) = 1 × 7 = 7

**∴ The required value is 7**

questions.question: Pawan travels from X to Y at the speed of 10 km/h, from Y to Z at 15 km/h and from Z to W at 20 km/h. If XY = YZ = ZW (in km), then the average speed of Pawan for the whole journey is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed at X to Y = 10 km/hr

Speed at Y to Z = 15 km/hr

Speed at Z to W = 20 km/hr

Distance of XY =Distance of YZ = Distance of ZW

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total Distance/Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the distance between XY, YZ and ZW each be x, respectively

So, Total time taken = (x/10) + (x/15) + (x/20) hours

⇒ (6x + 4x + 3x)/60 = 13x/60

Now, Total distance = (x + x + x) km

⇒ 3x km

Now, Average speed = 3x ÷ (13x/60)

⇒ 3x × (60/13x)

⇒ 180/13 km/hr = 13(11)/(13) km/hr

**∴ Average speed for the entire journey is 13(11)/(13) km/hr.**
